mapper.sql: CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, username, password_hash, display_name, account_type, enabled, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM account WHERE account_type=#{type} AND username=#{username}

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM account_role ar JOIN role r ON ar.role_id=r.id AND r.enabled=1 JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN permission p ON p.code=rp.permission_code AND p.enabled=1 WHERE ar.account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY p.code
SELECT CAST(w.id AS CHAR) FROM account_warehouse aw JOIN warehouse w ON aw.warehouse_id=w.id AND w.enabled=1 WHERE aw.account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY w.id
SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) FROM account_role ar JOIN role r ON ar.role_id=r.id AND r.enabled=1 WHERE ar.account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY r.id
